notes: Technical description for Sepolia (chain 11155111). IMDO supports a public treasury buying and retiring ecological credits on Regen Network; the contracts do not perform or verify those retirements. Holders receive no payouts, rewards, yield or staking. Both contracts are in src/IMDOFeeHook.sol. IMDOToken has no constructor arguments, mints its fixed supply once to its deployer, supports untaxed ERC-20 transfers and holder-only burn(uint256), and has no owner, later minting, blacklist, pause, trading gate or upgrade mechanism. Supply and allocations remain subject to the separately versioned launch policy. The hook constructor takes IPoolManager then the launch token. Its address must satisfy address & 0x3fff == 0x25d4 (9684). All declared callbacks require PoolManager; beforeInitialize binds one pool. The factory must deploy the token and mined hook and initialize the attached pool atomically. Currency0 is native ETH and currency1 is IMDO. The 3000 ppm (0.3%) LP fee and spacing 60 match the integration fixture. With no initial quote specified in the brief, initialPrice follows test/IMDO.t.sol: TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(69060), about 997.901649 IMDO per ETH. Buys pay zero hook fee. Sells use actual token input from afterSwap BalanceDelta and a one-block-lagged pool token inventory. Cumulative sells per tx.origin use transient storage: below 100 bps pays 0 ppm; 100 to below 300 bps pays 5000 ppm; 300 to below 500 bps pays 10000 ppm; 500 bps or more pays 20000 ppm. Positive sales without a prior reserve snapshot use the 20000 ppm cap. Fees round up. Exact-input fees reduce ETH output and go directly to immutable treasury 0xb1eC9d1C36974d05eb9889eBf8A150b05791E559. Exact-output fees add IMDO input and burn it; specified ETH output is unchanged. Failed payments accrue ERC-6909 claims. Anyone may call harvest() to redeem only tracked fees to that treasury or burn; failed redemption preserves claims. Rates, cap, treasury and burn behavior have no setters or upgrade path. The implementation follows BaseHookFee patterns with local ABI declarations, without inheriting OpenZeppelin BaseHookFee. Cumulative billing reprices earlier legs and converts mixed-side shortfalls at the current leg's realized price. Limitation: an exact-input leg collects at most its ETH output; remaining shortfall carries to later sells in that transaction but expires if none follow, so complete cumulative collection is not guaranteed. The pool LP fee remains credited to liquidity positions; the factory retains its own fee collection, recipients and distribution. Hook fees are separate. Tests use a real PoolManager with a model factory position and Merkle distributor; production factory payout recipients and swarm integration remain unverified. Deployment helpers are in script/Deploy.s.sol. No deployment, signed release attestation or audit is claimed.
